---
title: "Data model"
---

Fair Data Finder stores information in one PostgreSQL database with two
schemas:

| Schema | Contents | Managed by |
|--------|----------|------------|
| `pgstac` | STAC Collections and Items (domains and datasets) | `pypgstac migrate` |
| `public` | Users, groups, roles, keyword vocabulary | Alembic |

This page describes the important entities and how they relate. It is an
overview, not a full dump of every column.

## Entity overview

```{mermaid}
erDiagram
  User ||--o{ GroupUserLink : member_of
  Group ||--o{ GroupUserLink : has
  Group ||--o{ GroupRole : has
  Facility ||--o{ FacilityKeywordGroupLink : has
  Keyword_Group ||--o{ FacilityKeywordGroupLink : in
  Keyword_Group ||--o{ Keyword : contains

  Collection ||--o{ Item : contains
  Collection }o--o| Facility : "link rel=keywords"
  Item }o--o{ Keyword : "properties.keywords snapshot"
```

Collections and Items live in **pgSTAC**. Users, groups, facilities, and
keywords live in the **public** schema. The dashed relationship between a
Collection and a Facility is a STAC link on the Collection, not a database
foreign key.

## Application entities (`public`)

### User

Represents a person who has signed in with SSO (or was seeded as an admin).

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `email` | Primary key |
| `username` | Display name |

Users appear in group-member dropdowns only after they have logged in at least
once (or been seeded). There is no separate “create user” action in the UI.

### Group

A named set of users used for authorization.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | UUID |
| `name` | Group name |
| `description` | Short description |

Membership is stored in `GroupUserLink` (`group_id`, `user_email`).

### GroupRole

Assigns a role to a group, either globally or for one Collection (domain).

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | UUID |
| `group_id` | Owning group |
| `role` | One of the roles below |
| `object` | `NULL` = global role; otherwise the STAC **collection id** |

**Roles**

| Role | Scope | Typical permissions |
|------|-------|---------------------|
| `admin` | Global | Keywords, groups, create collections, assign roles |
| `keyword_editor` | Global | Manage keyword vocabulary (`keyword:all`) |
| `application_data_steward` | Global | Groups, create collections, assign collection roles |
| `collection_data_steward` | Collection | Create/update/delete items and the collection |
| `data_producer` | Collection | Create and update items |

Permissions are derived in application code from the role (there is no
separate permissions table).

### Facility

A keyword vocabulary container that can be linked to one or more domains.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | UUID |
| `name` | Facility name |

In the Keywords tab this is the top level of the vocabulary. In the Domains
tab, a domain can link to a facility via a Collection link with
`rel: "keywords"`.

### Keyword_Group

A named group of keywords inside one or more facilities.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | UUID |
| `group_name_nl` / `group_name_en` | Dutch and English names |
| `facility_type` | Type filter (for example numerical modelling) |

Linked to facilities through `FacilityKeywordGroupLink`.

### Keyword

A single controlled term.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | UUID |
| `nl_keyword` / `en_keyword` | Dutch and English labels |
| `external_id` | Optional external identifier |
| `group_id` | Parent keyword group |

## STAC entities (`pgstac`)

### Collection (Domain)

Represents a **domain**. Important fields used by Fair Data Finder:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` / `title` | Domain identifier and title |
| `description` | Domain description |
| `license` | Set to `proprietary` when created in the UI |
| `extent` | Spatial bbox and temporal interval |
| `links` | May include `{ rel: "keywords", id: "<facility UUID>", href: "/facilities/..." }` |

### Item (Dataset)

Represents a **dataset**. Core STAC fields plus Fair Data Finder properties
are documented under [Metadata schema](metadata-schema.qmd).

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | Item identifier |
| `collection` | Parent domain (Collection id) |
| `geometry` / `bbox` | Spatial footprint; may be `null` |
| `properties` | Metadata (title, keywords, dates, …) |
| `assets` | Map of data-access assets |

## What is *not* modelled as an entity

- **Project** — only `properties.projectNumber` on an Item
- **Domain table** — domains are Collections in pgSTAC
- **Permission table** — permissions come from the role enum mapping
